# Description

Calculates different number of test variable for use in the models.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
hpa <-
  read_csv(here::here(
    "..",
    "..",
    "..",
    "..",
    "HPI (DNR XXXXXX)",
    "Data HPI registeruttag 2023",
    "HPI",
    "HPI clean",
    "EEB_hpb_clean_2023-10-16.csv"
  )) %>%
  filter(
    rowSums(
      !is.na(select(
        .,
        EkB_rel_VO2,
        Astrand_rel_VO2,
        HeightCM,
        WeightKG,
        BloodPressureSystolic,
        BloodPressureDiastolic
      ))
    ) >=
      2,
    rowSums(
      !is.na(select(
        .,
        ExerciseAnswer,
        TobaccoSmoking,
        Diet,
        Health,
        StressOverall,
        SymptomBackNeck
      ))
    ) >=
      2
  )

# get time in study, change if time in study changes
hpa_risk_time <-
  read_csv(here::here("..", "data", "df_paper_3_CVD_2025-03-05.csv")) |>
  select(LopNr, risk_time_art, Performed, censor_date, treated) |>
  filter(treated == "1")


# data from earlier paper with number of tests that each participant have performed
# hpi_first_last <- read_csv(here::here("data", "paper2_riskdataset_first_last_20240618.csv"))

```

```{r}
# counting how many tests each LopNr has
df_time_test_count <-
  df1 <-
    hpa |>
    select(
      LopNr,
      Performed
    ) |>
    left_join(
      hpa_risk_time |>
        distinct(LopNr, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
        select(!Performed, LopNr),
      by = join_by(LopNr)
    ) |>

    group_by(LopNr) |>
    arrange(Performed) |>
    mutate(
      first_test_date = min(Performed, na.rm = TRUE),
      within_5 = if_else(Performed <= first_test_date + days(1826), 1, 0)
    ) |>
    # filter to only tests within 5 years from first test
    filter(within_5 == 1) |>
    ungroup()


df2 <- df1 |>
  select(LopNr, Performed) |>
  arrange(LopNr, Performed) |>
  group_by(LopNr) |>
  mutate(
    n_tests_within_5 = n(),
    test_number = row_number()
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_tests_within_5 = first(n_tests_within_5),
    first_test_date = min(Performed, na.rm = TRUE),
    second_test_date = if_else(n() >= 2, nth(Performed, 2), NA_Date_),
    last_test_date = max(Performed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    days_first_to_second = if_else(
      !is.na(second_test_date),
      as.numeric(second_test_date - first_test_date),
      NA_real_
    ),
    days_first_to_last = as.numeric(last_test_date - first_test_date)
  )


```

# life-style variables
## and join with number of HPAs
```{r}
# lifestyle variables for first, second, and last test within 5 years
df_lifestyle_n_hpa <-
  hpa_risk_time |>
  distinct(LopNr, .keep_all = TRUE) |> # get one row per LopNr from hpa_risk_time
  left_join(
    df2,
    by = join_by(LopNr)
  ) |>
  # get lifestyle variables for first test
  left_join(
    hpa |>
      filter(!is.na(Performed)) |>
      select(
        LopNr,
        Performed,
        ExerciseAnswer,
        TobaccoSmoking,
        Health,
        StressOverall,
        Astrand_rel_VO2,
        BMI
      ),
    by = join_by(LopNr, first_test_date == Performed)
  ) |>
  # get lifestyle variables for second test
  left_join(
    hpa |>
      filter(!is.na(Performed)) |>
      select(
        LopNr,
        Performed,
        ExerciseAnswer,
        TobaccoSmoking,
        Health,
        StressOverall,
        Astrand_rel_VO2,
        BMI
      ) |>
      rename_with(~ paste0(., "_second"), .cols = -c(LopNr, Performed)),
    by = join_by(LopNr, second_test_date == Performed)
  ) |>
  # get lifestyle variables for last test within 5 years
  left_join(
    hpa |>
      filter(!is.na(Performed)) |>
      select(
        LopNr,
        Performed,
        ExerciseAnswer,
        TobaccoSmoking,
        Health,
        StressOverall,
        Astrand_rel_VO2,
        BMI
      ) |>
      rename_with(~ paste0(., "_last"), .cols = -c(LopNr, Performed)),
    by = join_by(LopNr, last_test_date == Performed)
  )


```

# save

```{r}
write_csv(
  df_lifestyle_n_hpa,
  here::here("..", "data", "df_n_tests_CVD_2025-03-05.csv")
)
```
